text:
maria: Spike idea  should we offer a first-class "Share link" / pin button that emits a stable shortlink (and optionally a snapshot token) so product teams can link to exact pages without brittle UI state?

sam: Shortlink service sounds useful. big preference: default link = canonical path (stable), snapshot only if user explicitly chooses "Share current view". avoid serializing ephemeral UI.

lina: Breadcrumbs & automation concern: the breadcrumb path must always reflect the canonical resource path (Org > Project > Model > Version). shortlinks should resolve to the canonical path + snapshot playback, not a changed breadcrumb label.

alex: Implementation notes: two-layer model: 1) short id -> canonical path (no UI state) 2) optional snapshot token -> deltas for view state (panels open, filter selections). snapshot tokens should be opaque and revocable.

ethan: A11y considerations: when a shortlink rehydrates a snapshot, we must 1) set document.title 2) focus main heading 3) announce with aria-live ("Snapshot restored: filters applied") so screen reader users aren't surprised.

julia: Security: avoid embedding sensitive query params in shortlinks. If snapshot would reveal PII or API keys, require auth-check or refuse to persist that state. also add expiry for snapshot tokens by default (e.g., 90d).

maria: UX question  where does the pin button live? top-right of page next to share/copy url? or in breadcrumb dropdown?

sam: top-right makes sense for discoverability. also add a small chevron to let users choose "Share canonical" vs "Share view (snapshot)". default to canonical.

lina: Copy: label the default action "Copy link" and the other option "Copy link + view". tooltip: "Canonical link is stable across UI changes."

alex: Migration/back-compat: preserve behavior for legacy hash routes with a router shim. Also allow shortlinks to encode legacy hashes for a migration window so 3rd-party docs keep working. log legacy hits for 60 days.

ethan: Accessibility extra: if the snapshot includes expanded flyouts, the playback should avoid auto-opening interactive controls; instead restore visual state but keep focus on the main heading. let users tab into panels voluntarily. announce that panels are closed but state was restored.

julia: Telemetry: when a shortlink is created emit event: shortlink.create {owner, type: canonical|snapshot, expires_at}. when resolved: shortlink.resolve {success, legacy_route_handled}. helps measure stability and adoption.

alex: Shortlink design doc sketch: mapping table in DB: id -> {canonical_path, snapshot_id?}. Admin API to revoke tokens and a background job to prune expired tokens. Keep canonical path resolution idempotent so future route refactors update mapping where necessary.

maria: Example UX flow: user clicks "Copy link + view" -> backend stores snapshot + returns `https://console.redwood.ai/s/7Gf9k` -> visiting that link redirects to `https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/acro/projects/phoenix/models/phoenix-13b?eval=42` and then replays snapshot overlays (non-interactive) if allowed. we should surface that redirect briefly and allow users to copy the canonical path from the location bar.

sam: Also: add `?nav=compact` and documented query params list for power users. shortlinks should expand into that canonical+params if needed, not into ephemeral hashes.

lina: Copy tweak: when share link resolves and restores UI, show a small non-modal toast: "View restored from share link  press Esc to dismiss" with `aria-live=polite`.

ethan: Edge case: shared eval results that are behind permission checks. shortlink.resolve must validate permission and if unauthorized show a landing explaining why, not a 404. telemetry for failed resolves.

julia: Ops: rotate shortlink signing keys periodically and support revocation. for snapshots storing only diffs reduces size and risk.

prod-bot: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/preview-sharelink-service (preview/sharelink-service)  includes shortlink create flow + snapshot playback prototype.

sam: i'll run an a11y sweep on preview tomorrow (announce on restore, focus behavior, keyboard actions for share menu).

maria: Next steps: 1) eng spike for shortlink service + revocation 2) design to mock share UX variations (breadcrumb dropdown vs top-right) 3) a11y to validate restore announcements and focus rules 4) product to draft retention and expiry policy.

alex: i'll write a short migration appendix for router shim + legacy hash handling and share it here.

maria: thanks everyone  seems like consensus on canonical-by-default, opt-in snapshot tokens, and conservative expiry + security checks. i'll post final mock later. :rocket:
